t: The one case where saying more than you know is not lying
a: لَيْسَ بِالْكَاذِبِ مَنْ أَصْلَحَ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ فَقَالَ خَيْرًا أَوْ نَمَى خَيْرًا
p: Laysa bi-l-kādhibi man aṣlaḥa bayna-n-nāsi fa-qāla khayran aw namā khayrā
m: He is not a liar who puts things right between people, saying something good or passing on something good.
